messages:
jin: quick pass after the design sync — two items: heatmap color ramp for error-rate view and inline syntax token contrast in the query inspector. both feel a little off in midnight.

sasha: agreed. heatmap currently uses a bluish sequential ramp and low -> high jumps are subtle. when you have spikes they don't 'pop'. thinking a diverging ramp (teal -> amber) with a neutral midpoint might surface anomalies better.

omar: diverging could help, but watch for colorblind-safe choices. also the legend swatches are tiny (8px) and lose meaning on mobile. bump to 12px?

jin: yep bump legend to 12px recommended. sasha can you mock 2 variants: diverging and boosted sequential (higher chroma)? throw both in a quick figma frame.

sasha: will do. also found a weird thing: inline strings in the query inspector are using the same hue as positive metric tags, which causes confusion. suggest string token -> slightly cooler teal and metric-tag -> brighter green.

omar: accessibility note: small token text (10px) must stay >=4.5:1. a11y-bot, can you run a quick pre-check once sasha uploads tokens?

a11y-bot: sure — ping me when uploaded. quick callout: hover/focus outlines for legend items are currently 1px semi-transparent white; keyboard focus is hard to see on dark panels. Recommend 2px solid focus ring (#2bd9aa @ 90%) or using outline-offset for clarity.

ryan: copy nit: dashboard header "Latency distribution" -> suggest "Latency distribution — p50 / p95" so it's explicit. also for the heatmap tooltip, show absolute counts not just percentage. product asked for that.

jin: good catch, ryan. sasha add the header change to your mock and add absolute counts to tooltip spec.

sasha: uploaded frame: /design/heatmap-diverge-v1 and tokens: tokens/heatmap-diverge.json. diverging uses midpoint #2f3438, low #0f1b1a teal, high #ffb36b amber. legend swatches increased to 12px. query string token -> #59e0c7, metric-tag -> #3fe67a.

a11y-bot: running contrast checks...
- string token (#59e0c7) vs panel bg: 4.6:1 ✅
- metric-tag (#3fe67a) vs panel bg: 5.2:1 ✅
- heatmap high (#ffb36b) vs panel bg: 4.0:1 ⚠️ (below 4.5 for small markers)
- legend swatch + small label: 4.3:1 ⚠️ (just below threshold)
Recommendation: slightly darken amber to `#ff9a40` and increase legend label weight by 100 if we can't darken further.

omar: prefer darkening amber slightly — keeps visual metaphor. sasha, can you try `#ff9a40` and re-export? also implement the stronger keyboard focus ring as a token.

sasha: will update frame and token PR. i'll also include a tiny gif showing hover vs focus for legend items.

jin: final asks: add a short note in tokens.json explaining why the diverging ramp was chosen (anomaly detection), and add a checkbox to the release checklist: "contrast regression: heatmap & inspector tokens". once tokens pass a11y-bot, design-bot can merge.

(attachments: figma_heatmap_diverge_v1.png, token_diff.patch, gif_legend_focus.mp4)
